## google-maps-api-skill v0.1.2 Changelog

- No source file changes detected in this release.
- Documentation (SKILL.md) content remains unchanged. 
- No new features, bug fixes, or behavior adjustments noted.
- Version bump only; functionality is unchanged from the previous release.

- SKILL.md rewritten for clarity, conciseness, and easier agent integration; metadata block added.
- Environment and execution instructions revised for improved agent/user guidance.
- Error handling and retry policy clarified with explicit agent instructions.
- Outdated explanations and excess wording removed.
- Python script removed from repository.

Initial release of google-maps-api-skill – automate business data scraping from Google Maps.

- Scrapes structured business information such as names, addresses, contacts, ratings, and more via BrowserAct Google Maps API.
- Designed for lead generation, competitor research, contact extraction, and local business analysis.
- Bypasses CAPTCHA, geo-fencing, and IP restrictions for reliable global operation.
- Requires user to provide and configure a BrowserAct API Key before use.
- Monitors execution and auto-retries on failure (one retry limit), with clear user guidance on errors.
- Outputs clean, actionable business datasets for downstream applications and workflows.
